name: C4
description: The Colossal Clean Crawled Corpus (C4) is a cleaned English-language web-text dataset derived from Common Crawl for language-model pretraining. This record does not distribute corpus data.
citation: Raffel, C., Shazeer, N., Roberts, A., Lee, K., Narang, S., Matena, M., Zhou, Y., Li, W., & Liu, P. J. (2020). Exploring the Limits of Transfer Learning with a Unified Text-to-Text Transformer. Journal of Machine Learning Research, 21(140), 1–67. https://jmlr.org/papers/v21/20-074.html
